name: letterpress-card-flip
title: Letterpress Card Flip
description: A business card with letterpress-printed type that flips in 3D on click to reveal contact details on the reverse — two independent letterpress faces, real transform-style 3D, and keyboard focus parity.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Muted Earth

## Rules

- Click Flip 3d: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
